title: Cilium Certified Associate (CCA)
releaseBlockers: the exam's Cilium version is not published; cards follow the 1.20 docs
description: CCA: every idea explained before it is tested, every card quoting the source words it rests on.
sourceShort: the Cilium documentation, ebpf.io and the Kubernetes docs
notice: Cilium, Cilium Certified Associate, Envoy and Kubernetes are registered trademarks of The Linux Foundation. This deck is independent and is not affiliated with, sponsored, endorsed or approved by The Linux Foundation or the Cloud Native Computing Foundation.

checks.what: Three independent audits read all 679 cards against the Cilium 1.20 documentation, ebpf.io and the Kubernetes docs they quote, found word for word by the card checker, including every command, Helm value, port and YAML snippet and the three figures
checks.result: Six wrong cards fixed, among them a claim that identities are shared through a key-value store by default (1.20 uses Kubernetes custom resources), an out-of-date rule on identity-relevant labels, and a Helm command that could not produce the error it described; the components figure redrawn to show the Hubble CLI as a client tool; 4 ambiguous cards, 4 unsupported claims and 2 unclear ones fixed.
